MemberOf.remediation: Remove unnecessary group membership and enforce just-in-time administrative access.

AdminTo.remediation: Limit local administrator rights and rotate local admin credentials with LAPS.

HasSession.remediation: Reduce privileged interactive logons and isolate administrative workstations.

GenericWrite.remediation: Remove GenericWrite delegation or scope it to specific required attributes.

WriteDacl.remediation: Remove WriteDacl rights and audit ACL changes on high-value objects.

WriteOwner.remediation: Remove WriteOwner rights and monitor ownership changes.

AddMember.remediation: Restrict who can modify group membership and alert on privileged group changes.

AllowedToDelegate.remediation: Review constrained delegation and remove unnecessary SPN delegation paths.

DCSync.remediation: Restrict directory replication permissions and alert on replication API abuse.

Owns.remediation: Reset object owner to an approved administrative group.

CanRDP.remediation: Restrict RDP rights and require privileged access workstations.
